description: Make a finished request live: every endpoint that passed its checks becomes part of the public API. Publishing changes what everyone who calls the API gets, so do it only when the user asked for it. Works once get_build_status says the request is ready. Needs an API key with the requests:publish permission.

request_id.description: The request_id from request_endpoint or create_api.

name: publish_request
title: Publish a maviapi request
